name: The 'Red Fort' on the river at Guangzhou (Canton)
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of the 'Red Fort' located by the southern shore of the Pearl River, opposite the site of the Western trading bases or 'factories' at Guangzhou (Canton). For other drawings of this fort see E.1769-1928 and E.1780-1928.
